violated_contract: An idempotent ingest identity retired by explicit user deletion must remain retired after the content row is removed. Treating absence as a new create allows a delayed local outbox retry to recreate deleted content and rerun its derived-data pipeline.
canonical_prevention: Persist content-free deletion intent before destructive cleanup, point-read that intent before admitting a client-bound create, acknowledge retired identities without processing, and resolve the producing local outbox row on that acknowledgement.
